item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera visits a beach near Chennai on a hot afternoon. During the day, the sand heats up faster than the sea water. The warm air above the sand rises, and cooler air moves in to take its place.

From which direction does the breeze blow near the coast at that time?

options.A: From the sea towards the land, because the sea is cooler than the sand during the day
options.B: From the land towards the sea, because the sand is warmer than the sea during the day
options.C: From the land towards the sea, because the sea always stays cooler than the land
options.D: There is no breeze, because the sand and the sea are at the same temperature
